verses.original: Οὐδὲν ἄρα νῦν κατάκριμα τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouden ara nyn katakrima tois en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, nada de condenação há para os que estão em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ νόμος τοῦ Πνεύματος τῆς ζωῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἠλευθέρωσέν σε ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου τῆς ἁμαρτίας καὶ τοῦ θανάτου
verses.transliteration: ho gar nomos tou Pneumatos tēs zōēs en Christō Iēsou ēleutherōsen se apo tou nomou tēs hamartias kai tou thanatou
verses.literal: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death
verses.literalPt: Pois a lei do Espírito da vida te livrou, em Cristo Jesus, da lei do pecado e da morte.

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ ἀδύνατον τοῦ νόμου ἐν ᾧ ἠσθένει διὰ τῆς σαρκός ὁ Θεὸς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ Υἱὸν πέμψας ἐν ὁμοιώματι σαρκὸς ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας κατέκρινεν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐν τῇ σαρκί
verses.transliteration: to gar adynaton tou nomou en hō ēsthenei dia tēs sarkos ho Theos ton heautou Huion pempsas en homoiōmati sarkos hamartias kai peri hamartias katekrinen tēn hamartian en tē sarki
verses.literal: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man as an offering for sin He thus condemned sin in the flesh
verses.literalPt: O que a Lei não podia fazer, no que se achava fraca pela carne, Deus, enviando a seu próprio Filho em semelhança de carne de pecado e por causa do pecado, condenou o pecado na carne;

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ νόμου πληρωθῇ ἐν ἡμῖν τοῖς μὴ κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦσιν ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: hina to dikaiōma tou nomou plērōthē en hēmin tois mē kata sarka peripatousin alla kata pneuma
verses.literal: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit
verses.literalPt: para que a exigência justa da Lei se cumprisse em nós, que não andamos segundo a carne, mas segundo o Espírito.

verses.original: Οἱ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ὄντες τὰ τῆς σαρκὸς φρονοῦσιν οἱ δὲ κατὰ πνεῦμα τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: Hoi gar kata sarka ontes ta tēs sarkos phronousin hoi de kata pneuma ta tou pneumatos
verses.literal: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit
verses.literalPt: Os que são segundo a carne põem a sua mente nas coisas da carne, mas os que são segundo o Espírito põem a sua mente nas coisas do Espírito.

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς θάνατος τὸ δὲ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος ζωὴ καὶ εἰρήνη
verses.transliteration: to gar phronēma tēs sarkos thanatos to de phronēma tou pneumatos zōē kai eirēnē
verses.literal: The mind of the flesh is death but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace
verses.literalPt: A mente da carne é morte, mas a mente do Espírito é vida e paz.

verses.original: διότι τὸ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς ἔχθρα εἰς Θεόν τῷ γὰρ νόμῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐχ ὑποτάσσεται οὐδὲ γὰρ δύναται
verses.transliteration: dioti to phronēma tēs sarkos echthra eis Theon tō gar nomō tou Theou ouch hypotassetai oude gar dynatai
verses.literal: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God It does not submit to God’s law nor can it do so
verses.literalPt: Pois a mente da carne é inimizade contra Deus, visto que não é sujeita à lei de Deus, nem o pode ser;

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ὄντες Θεῷ ἀρέσαι οὐ δύνανται
verses.transliteration: hoi de en sarki ontes Theō aresai ou dynantai
verses.literal: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God
verses.literalPt: os que estão sujeitos à carne não podem agradar a Deus.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ἀλλὰ ἐν πνεύματι εἴπερ Πνεῦμα Θεοῦ οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ δέ τις Πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ οὐκ ἔχει οὗτος οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de ouk este en sarki alla en pneumati eiper Pneuma Theou oikei en hymin ei de tis Pneuma Christou ouk echei houtos ouk estin autou
verses.literal: You however are controlled not by the flesh but by the Spirit if the Spirit of God lives in you And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ he does not belong to Christ
verses.literalPt: Vós, porém, não estais sujeitos à carne, mas ao Espírito, se realmente o Espírito de Deus habita em vós. Mas, se alguém não tem o Espírito de Cristo, esse não é dele.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν τὸ μὲν σῶμα νεκρὸν διὰ ἁμαρτίαν τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ζωὴ διὰ δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: ei de Christos en hymin to men sōma nekron dia hamartian to de pneuma zōē dia dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: But if Christ is in you your body is dead because of sin yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness
verses.literalPt: Se Cristo está em vós, o corpo, na verdade, está morto por causa do pecado, mas o espírito é vida por causa da justiça.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ ἐγείραντος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ νεκρῶν οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν ὁ ἐγείρας ἐκ νεκρῶν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ζωοποιήσει καὶ τὰ θνητὰ σώματα ὑμῶν διὰ τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος αὐτοῦ Πνεύματος ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ei de to Pneuma tou egeirantos ton Iēsoun ek nekrōn oikei en hymin ho egeiras ek nekrōn Christon Iēsoun zōopoiēsei kai ta thnēta sōmata hymōn dia tou enoikountos autou Pneumatos en hymin
verses.literal: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit who lives in you
verses.literalPt: Mas, se o Espírito daquele que ressuscitou a Jesus dentre os mortos habita em vós, aquele que ressuscitou a Cristo Jesus dentre os mortos também dará vida aos vossos corpos mortais, pelo seu Espírito, que habita em vós.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ἀδελφοί ὀφειλέται ἐσμέν οὐ τῇ σαρκὶ τοῦ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆν
verses.transliteration: Ara oun adelphoi opheiletai esmen ou tē sarki tou kata sarka zēn
verses.literal: Therefore . . . brothers we have an obligation but it is not to the flesh to live according to it
verses.literalPt: Portanto, irmãos, somos devedores não à carne, para que vivamos segundo a carne.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆτε μέλλετε ἀποθνήσκειν εἰ δὲ πνεύματι τὰς πράξεις τοῦ σώματος θανατοῦτε ζήσεσθε
verses.transliteration: ei gar kata sarka zēte mellete apothnēskein ei de pneumati tas praxeis tou sōmatos thanatoute zēsesthe
verses.literal: For if you live according to the flesh you will die but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body you will live
verses.literalPt: Se viverdes segundo a carne, haveis de morrer; mas, se pelo Espírito mortificardes as obras do corpo, vivereis.

verses.original: ὅσοι γὰρ Πνεύματι Θεοῦ ἄγονται οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hosoi gar Pneumati Theou agontai houtoi huioi eisin Theou
verses.literal: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God
verses.literalPt: Pois todos os que são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus, estes são filhos de Deus.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα δουλείας πάλιν εἰς φόβον ἀλλὰ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα υἱοθεσίας ἐν ᾧ κράζομεν Ἀββᾶ ὁ Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: Ou gar elabete pneuma douleias palin eis phobon alla elabete pneuma huiothesias en hō krazomen Abba ho Patēr
verses.literal: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear but you received the Spirit of adoption to sonship by whom we cry Abba Father
verses.literalPt: Não recebestes o espírito de escravidão, para estardes outra vez com temor, mas recebestes o espírito de adoção, pelo qual clamamos: Aba, Pai.

verses.original: αὐτὸ τὸ Πνεῦμα συμμαρτυρεῖ τῷ πνεύματι ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐσμὲν τέκνα Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: auto to Pneuma symmartyrei tō pneumati hēmōn hoti esmen tekna Theou
verses.literal: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children
verses.literalPt: O Espírito mesmo dá testemunho com o nosso espírito de que somos filhos de Deus.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ τέκνα καὶ κληρονόμοι κληρονόμοι μὲν Θεοῦ συνκληρονόμοι δὲ Χριστοῦ εἴπερ συμπάσχομεν ἵνα καὶ συνδοξασθῶμεν
verses.transliteration: ei de tekna kai klēronomoi klēronomoi men Theou synklēronomoi de Christou eiper sympaschomen hina kai syndoxasthōmen
verses.literal: And if we are children then we are heirs heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him
verses.literalPt: E, se filhos, também herdeiros; herdeiros de Deus e coerdeiros de Cristo, se realmente padecemos com ele, para que também com ele sejamos glorificados.

verses.original: Λογίζομαι γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἄξια τὰ παθήματα τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ πρὸς τὴν μέλλουσαν δόξαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Logizomai gar hoti ouk axia ta pathēmata tou nyn kairou pros tēn mellousan doxan apokalyphthēnai eis hēmas
verses.literal: I consider that our present . . . sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us
verses.literalPt: Tenho para mim que os sofrimentos da vida presente não têm valor em comparação com a glória que há de ser revelada em nós.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ ἀποκαραδοκία τῆς κτίσεως τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀπεκδέχεται
verses.transliteration: hē gar apokaradokia tēs ktiseōs tēn apokalypsin tōn huiōn tou Theou apekdechetai
verses.literal: The creation waits - in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God
verses.literalPt: A ardente expectativa da criação aguarda a manifestação dos filhos de Deus.

verses.original: τῇ γὰρ ματαιότητι ἡ κτίσις ὑπετάγη οὐχ ἑκοῦσα ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν ὑποτάξαντα ἐφ’ ἑλπίδι
verses.transliteration: tē gar mataiotēti hē ktisis hypetagē ouch hekousa alla dia ton hypotaxanta eph’ helpidi
verses.literal: For the creation was subjected to futility not by its own will but because of the One who subjected it in hope
verses.literalPt: Pois a criação ficou sujeita à vaidade, não voluntariamente, mas por causa daquele que a sujeitou,

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ αὐτὴ ἡ κτίσις ἐλευθερωθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς δουλείας τῆς φθορᾶς εἰς τὴν ἐλευθερίαν τῆς δόξης τῶν τέκνων τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti kai autē hē ktisis eleutherōthēsetai apo tēs douleias tēs phthoras eis tēn eleutherian tēs doxēs tōn teknōn tou Theou
verses.literal: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God
verses.literalPt: na esperança de que também a própria criação será libertada do cativeiro da corrupção para a liberdade da glória dos filhos de Deus.

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν γὰρ ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ κτίσις συστενάζει καὶ συνωδίνει ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν
verses.transliteration: Oidamen gar hoti pasa hē ktisis systenazei kai synōdinei achri tou nyn
verses.literal: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time
verses.literalPt: Ora, sabemos que toda a criação, juntamente, geme e está com dores de parto até agora;

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ αὐτοὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τοῦ Πνεύματος ἔχοντες ἡμεῖς καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς στενάζομεν υἱοθεσίαν ἀπεκδεχόμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν τοῦ σώματος ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: ou monon de alla kai autoi tēn aparchēn tou Pneumatos echontes hēmeis kai autoi en heautois stenazomen huiothesian apekdechomenoi tēn apolytrōsin tou sōmatos hēmōn
verses.literal: Not only that but we ourselves who have the firstfruits of the Spirit groan inwardly . . . . . . as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons the redemption of our bodies
verses.literalPt: e não só ela, mas também nós, embora tenhamos as primícias do Espírito, gememos ainda em nós mesmos, aguardando a nossa adoção, isto é, a redenção do nosso corpo.

verses.original: τῇ γὰρ ἐλπίδι ἐσώθημεν ἐλπὶς δὲ βλεπομένη οὐκ ἔστιν ἐλπίς ὃ γὰρ βλέπει τις τί ἐλπίζει
verses.transliteration: tē gar elpidi esōthēmen elpis de blepomenē ouk estin elpis ho gar blepei tis ti elpizei
verses.literal: For in this hope we were saved but hope that is seen is no hope at all Who . . . hopes for what he can already see
verses.literalPt: Pois, na esperança, fomos salvos; porém a esperança que se vê não é esperança; porque o que alguém vê, como o espera?

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ὃ οὐ βλέπομεν ἐλπίζομεν δι’ ὑπομονῆς ἀπεκδεχόμεθα
verses.transliteration: ei de ho ou blepomen elpizomen di’ hypomonēs apekdechometha
verses.literal: But if we hope for what we do not yet see we wait for it patiently
verses.literalPt: Mas, se esperamos o que não vemos, com perseverança o aguardamos.

verses.original: Ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα συναντιλαμβάνεται τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ ἡμῶν τὸ γὰρ τί προσευξώμεθα καθὸ δεῖ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ἀλλὰ αὐτὸ τὸ Πνεῦμα ὑπερεντυγχάνει στεναγμοῖς ἀλαλήτοις
verses.transliteration: Hōsautōs de kai to Pneuma synantilambanetai tē astheneia hēmōn to gar ti proseuxōmetha katho dei ouk oidamen alla auto to Pneuma hyperentynchanei stenagmois alalētois
verses.literal: In the same way . . . the Spirit helps us in our weakness For we do not know how we ought to pray but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words
verses.literalPt: Do mesmo modo, também o Espírito ajuda a nossa fraqueza; porque não sabemos o que havemos de pedir como convém, mas o Espírito mesmo intercede por nós com gemidos inexprimíveis;

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐραυνῶν τὰς καρδίας οἶδεν τί τὸ φρόνημα τοῦ Πνεύματος ὅτι κατὰ Θεὸν ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: ho de eraunōn tas kardias oiden ti to phronēma tou Pneumatos hoti kata Theon entynchanei hyper hagiōn
verses.literal: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God
verses.literalPt: e aquele que esquadrinha os corações sabe qual é a intenção do Espírito, que ele, segundo a vontade de Deus, intercede pelos santos.

verses.original: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν Θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ ὁ θεὸς εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
verses.transliteration: Oidamen de hoti tois agapōsin ton Theon panta synergei ho theos eis agathon tois kata prothesin klētois ousin
verses.literal: And we know that God works all things together . . . for the good of those who love Him who are called according to His purpose
verses.literalPt: Sabemos que aos que amam a Deus, todas as coisas lhes cooperam para o bem, a saber, aos que são chamados segundo o seu propósito.

verses.original: ὅτι οὓς προέγνω καὶ προώρισεν συμμόρφους τῆς εἰκόνος τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν πρωτότοκον ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: hoti hous proegnō kai proōrisen symmorphous tēs eikonos tou Huiou autou eis to einai auton prōtotokon en pollois adelphois
verses.literal: For those God foreknew He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers
verses.literalPt: Porque os que dantes conheceu também predestinou para serem conformes à imagem de seu Filho, a fim de que ele fosse o primogênito entre muitos irmãos;

verses.original: οὓς δὲ προώρισεν τούτους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν καὶ οὓς ἐκάλεσεν τούτους καὶ ἐδικαίωσεν οὓς δὲ ἐδικαίωσεν τούτους καὶ ἐδόξασεν
verses.transliteration: hous de proōrisen toutous kai ekalesen kai hous ekalesen toutous kai edikaiōsen hous de edikaiōsen toutous kai edoxasen
verses.literal: And those He predestined He also called those He called He also justified those He justified He also glorified
verses.literalPt: e aos que predestinou, a estes também chamou; e aos que chamou, a estes também justificou; e aos que justificou, a estes também glorificou.

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν πρὸς ταῦτα εἰ ὁ Θεὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τίς καθ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen pros tauta ei ho Theos hyper hēmōn tis kath’ hēmōn
verses.literal: What then shall we say in response to these things If God is for us who can be against us
verses.literalPt: Que diremos, pois, à vista dessas coisas? Se Deus é por nós, quem será contra nós?

verses.original: ὅς γε τοῦ ἰδίου Υἱοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων παρέδωκεν αὐτόν πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν χαρίσεται
verses.transliteration: hos ge tou idiou Huiou ouk epheisato alla hyper hēmōn pantōn paredōken auton pōs ouchi kai syn autō ta panta hēmin charisetai
verses.literal: He who did not spare . . . His own Son but gave Him up for us all how will He not also along with Him freely give us all things
verses.literalPt: Aquele que não poupou a seu próprio Filho, mas por todos nós o entregou, como não nos dará também com ele todas as coisas?

verses.original: τίς ἐγκαλέσει κατὰ ἐκλεκτῶν Θεοῦ Θεὸς ὁ δικαιῶν
verses.transliteration: tis enkalesei kata eklektōn Theou Theos ho dikaiōn
verses.literal: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect It is God who justifies
verses.literalPt: Quem formará acusação contra os escolhidos de Deus? É Deus quem os justifica.

verses.original: τίς ὁ κατακρινῶν Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀποθανών μᾶλλον δὲ ἐγερθείς ὅς καί ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὃς καὶ ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: tis ho katakrinōn Christos Iēsous ho apothanōn mallon de egertheis hos kai estin en dexia tou Theou hos kai entynchanei hyper hēmōn
verses.literal: Who is there to condemn us For Christ Jesus who died and more than that was raised to life is at the right hand of God and He is interceding for us
verses.literalPt: Quem é o que os condena? Cristo Jesus é o que morreu ou, antes, o que foi ressuscitado, o que está à mão direita de Deus, o que também intercede por nós!

verses.original: Τίς ἡμᾶς χωρίσει ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Χριστοῦ θλῖψις ἢ στενοχωρία ἢ διωγμὸς ἢ λιμὸς ἢ γυμνότης ἢ κίνδυνος ἢ μάχαιρα
verses.transliteration: Tis hēmas chōrisei apo tēs agapēs tou Christou thlipsis ē stenochōria ē diōgmos ē limos ē gymnotēs ē kindynos ē machaira
verses.literal: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword
verses.literalPt: Quem nos separará do amor de Cristo? Será tribulação, ou angústia, ou perseguição, ou fome, ou nudez, ou perigo, ou espada?

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Ἕνεκεν σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai hoti Heneken sou thanatoumetha holēn tēn hēmeran elogisthēmen hōs probata sphagēs
verses.literal: As it is written For Your sake . . . we face death all day long we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered
verses.literalPt: Como está escrito: Por amor de ti, somos entregues à morte o dia todo, fomos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἐν τούτοις πᾶσιν ὑπερνικῶμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: All’ en toutois pasin hypernikōmen dia tou agapēsantos hēmas
verses.literal: No in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us
verses.literalPt: Mas, em todas essas coisas, somos mais que vencedores por aquele que nos amou.

verses.original: πέπεισμαι γὰρ ὅτι οὔτε θάνατος οὔτε ζωὴ οὔτε ἄγγελοι οὔτε ἀρχαὶ οὔτε ἐνεστῶτα οὔτε μέλλοντα οὔτε δυνάμεις
verses.transliteration: pepeismai gar hoti oute thanatos oute zōē oute angeloi oute archai oute enestōta oute mellonta oute dynameis
verses.literal: For I am convinced that neither death nor life neither angels nor principalities neither the present nor the future nor any powers
verses.literalPt: Pois estou persuadido de que nem a morte, nem a vida, nem os anjos, nem os principados, nem as coisas presentes

verses.original: οὔτε ὕψωμα οὔτε βάθος οὔτε τις κτίσις ἑτέρα δυνήσεται ἡμᾶς χωρίσαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: oute hypsōma oute bathos oute tis ktisis hetera dynēsetai hēmas chōrisai apo tēs agapēs tou Theou tēs en Christō Iēsou tō Kyriō hēmōn
verses.literal: neither height nor depth nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord
verses.literalPt: nem as futuras, nem os poderes, nem a altura, nem a profundidade, nem qualquer outra criatura nos poderá separar do amor de Deus, que é em Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.
